heroSlides.desc: End-to-end logistics and courier solutions with operational excellence, global reach and a commitment to trust, safety and timely delivery across 190+ countries.
Connecting 190+ countries with priority doorstep pickup across South India for commercial samples, urgent documents, and specialized NRI parcels.
Dedicated seaport and airport customs house brokerage with direct ICEGATE EDI filing, bonded warehousing, and multi-modal freight transport.

about.title: We Are The Bridge Between You And Your Relations.
about.description: Delivering uncompromised trust, maritime operational rigor, and door-to-door courier precision connecting South India's industrial and family roots to 190+ countries worldwide.

services.title: Six Proven Channels.
services.description: From time-critical vessel spares delivery on-board at outer anchorage berths to worldwide express courier and heavy air/ocean freight forwarders, Flymingo Logistics handles every consignment with shipowner precision.

contact.title: Direct Lines.
contact.description: Reach our logistics coordinators directly for emergency vessel spare dispatches, international door courier pickups, dangerous goods compliance, and air cargo bookings.

ship-spares.title: Ship Spares &
ship-spares.description: Time-critical marine replacement parts cleared through customs and delivered direct to the vessel deck, without port detention.

freight-forwarding.title: Air & Ocean
freight-forwarding.description: Direct contracts with premier airlines and ocean carriers for expedited air cargo and full container loads across major global trade lanes.

international-courier.title: Worldwide Priority
international-courier.description: Express transit to USA, UK, Europe, UAE, and 190+ countries with door pickup across Tamil Nadu, automated tracking, and transparent rates.

customs-clearance.title: Seaport & Airport
customs-clearance.description: In-house licensed customs house agent filing direct EDI through ICEGATE, handling export-import clearance, bonded warehousing, and duty drawback.

dg-shipping.title: Certified
dg-shipping.description: Certified hazmat logistics complying with IATA-DGR and IMDG codes, featuring UN-certified packaging, shipper's declaration (DGD), and safe transport.

international-relocation.title: Turnkey Overseas
international-relocation.description: Door-to-door overseas moving with multi-layer export crating, transfer of residence (TR) customs documentation, container shipping, and destination delivery.
